title: First-Person Resolve
grade_notes: Shot 1: Crush blacks heavily to hide floor clutter, leaving only the boots in the low light. Shot 2: Desaturate the yellows of the engine, lift highlights on the chrome of the wrench. Shot 3: Maintain deep shadows in the bin, letting the white glove be the primary exposure point. Shot 4: Apply heavy vignette; crush the background to black, focusing light only on the hands inside the chassis.
sound_note: A low, cinematic sub-bass pulse that cuts to the sharp, metallic click of a socket wrench at 0:08.

title: The Final Residue
grade_notes: Shot 1: High contrast to make the black grease on white plastic look like ink. Shot 2: Shift blue coolant toward a desaturated teal/cyan to match the noir palette. Shot 3: Lift the 'wetness' of the exhaust pipe in the midtones to emphasize the residue. Shot 4: Crush shadows until the subject's legs are silhouettes framing the mess.
sound_note: Quiet, rhythmic industrial drone with the tactile sound of a cloth dragging over plastic emphasized in the first and last shots.
